storeDesc.message:
Use AI Checker as a ChatGPT detector or as an AI generator checker to detect artificial intelligence in a paper, essay, or text.
 
Do you want to know if something was written by a human or generated by AI? You can scan it with AI Checker directly in your browser without opening another tab.
 
🚀 How to start?
1. Install the AI Checker extension by clicking the “Add to Chrome” button.
2. Select text from a webpage, document, learning platform, email, or online submission.
3. Right-click to start ai check.

AI Checker is a Chrome browser extension that combines many different tools. It can work as an AI generator checker, a ChatGPT detector, or a simple AI essay checker. Instead of opening another webpage, you can launch AI Checker by selecting a block of text and right-clicking. You will see the result right away on the same page.
 
AI Checker key features include:
➤ Artificial intelligence detection becomes part of your normal workflow
➤ Text selection is very quick
➤ Supports different types of writing, so you can check ai everywhere
➤ Saves a history of AI checked content
 
AI Checker provides an access to several tools:
* chat gpt detector
* AI text checker
* artificial intelligence finder
 
Chrome extension might be useful for teachers, students, editors, writers, marketers, recruiters or other professionals to check for ai in seconds.
 
What kind of documents can it check for ai?
It can be:
* essays
* emails
* articles
* reports
* social media posts
* and many other documents you want to detect artificial intelligence
 
It’s important to note that there is no AI checker that can provide absolute proof that a document was created by artificial intelligence or a human. AI writing checker shall only be used to decide whether the content requires further review. Artificial intelligence text detector may occasionally provide false-positive or false-negative results. Results might be affected by text length. To make results more reliable, provide a full paragraph or document for the artificial intelligence content detector to analyse.
 
To further assess results, consider:
✓ the author’s writing style based on other documents
✓ references and links
✓ structure, logic and reasoning
✓ further conversation with the author
 
Frequently Asked Questions:
❓ Does AI Checker work only in Chrome?
* Yes, it’s built as a Chrome extension to detect artificial intelligence in your browser.
❓ Where does artificial intelligence text detector save the results?
* You can find previous results in the History tab.
❓ How much text should I select for chatgpt scanner?
* The minimum is 50 words. To make ai content checker results more reliable, provide the more context or full document.
❓ Can chatgpt detector be used by teachers?
* Yes, it can be used as ai checker for teachers to review student work.
❓ Can I scan the text directly in Chrome?
* Yes, select the text and right-click to review content with chatgpt detector.
❓ What types of writing can chatgpt detector analyse?
* AI detection checker can work with any type of document if you open it in Chrome.
❓ Does it detect text written by ChatGPT?
* Yes, it works as chatgpt scanner to highlight the content created by AI.
❓ Does it guarantee accurate results?
* No, based on the most recent tests, artificial intelligence detector is only 99% accurate.
❓ Can I used the extension for my emails or social media post?
* Yes, open it in Google Chrome and select the text you want to be scanned.
❓ Can I replace my manual review by results from the extension?
* No, it can help you to conduct the review quicker. However, always review the document manually and think of its writing style, logic and reasoning and review the references and links.
❓ Is it possible that two similar texts receive different results?
* Yes, even small changes in wording, punctuation, length may have an impact on the results.
❓ Do I need to pin the extension to Chrome tool bar?
* It’s not necessary but might help you to find the extension easier.
❓ Can I find out which tool was used to create the text?
* No, it’s only possible to analyse whether the content was created by a human.
❓ What if the text combines human and chatgpt writing?
* You would receive the result showing the percentage.
 
🚀 Do you feel ready and curious to review your text?
-> Simply download the extension, select any text, right-click and see the result right away. Please remember to use the report as an indication additional to your own review and judgement.
It’s makes it easier to review any document online.
